title: Command Palette doesn't have options for new modules

status.label: Needs Information
status.detail: Command Palette 0.99.0 Settings search returns no commands for the newer Grab and Move or Power Display modules.

next_action.label: Confirm missing Settings commands
next_action.reason: Confirm the current extension build before proposing a command catalogue change.

judgment.rationale: The report does not distinguish a missing catalogue entry from page registration or stale extension cache. Reuse the supplied evidence and ask only whether this persists on current stable and which extension package is installed.
judgment.recommended_action: Confirm the current extension build before proposing a command catalogue change.

fix_assessment.rationale: The likely PowerToys path remains uncertain; the proposed direction is provisional and paired with the specific evidence request.

proposed_fixes.title: Refresh the Settings extension command catalogue for current modules
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The Settings extension command catalogue may be static and omit newer registered module pages; this awaits confirmation of extension build and module registration.
plan: Trace how the Settings extension discovers module pages and searchable command names.
Include registered module pages in the command catalogue rather than maintaining an incomplete static list.
Test that Grab and Move and Power Display settings commands are discoverable when present.
verification: Search both terms on a current build with the modules installed.
Verify each result opens the corresponding settings page.

confidence.rationale: The report shows exact missing terms, but the extension build and module registration path are not identified.

issue_context.summary: Command Palette 0.99.0 Settings search returns no commands for the newer Grab and Move or Power Display modules.
known_information: The reporter searched the PowerToys Settings extension for “grab and move” and “power display”.
A screenshot and bug-report ZIP are attached.
The expected commands are open-module or open-settings entries.
inferences: The extension may have a static command catalogue missing newer modules, or those module pages may not be registered for search.
issue_context.analysis: The report does not distinguish a missing catalogue entry from page registration or stale extension cache. Reuse the supplied evidence and ask only whether this persists on current stable and which extension package is installed.
initial_investigation: Pinned CmdPal source includes its UI/host but no Power Display or Grab and Move command provider in the checked-in extension tree.
Timeline links a closed broader Command Palette report, not a covering fix for these missing module commands.

information_gaps.information: Whether both terms remain missing on latest stable and whether CmdPal is bundled or separately installed.
information_gaps.why_needed: This report predates current releases and the installation method affects which Settings extension is present.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Check About and package details, then repeat both searches; the existing bug-report ZIP need not be reattached.

comment.body: Thanks for the screenshot and the file already attached; they show both searches returning no result. Could you confirm whether both searches are still empty on the latest stable build and whether Command Palette is bundled or separately installed? Please do not reattach the existing file. This distinguishes a stale 0.99 catalogue from missing module-page registration.
